(2) “Chair taps out / goes to vote / passes gavel” vibe is present in CHRG-118shrg59705_p0007_10 and CHRG-113shrg87249_p0016—explicit handoff language about going to vote and another senator chairing. These are structurally similar to the remembered ‘chair yields/steps out’ beat, though not tied to Vermont/Sanders here. (3) The Becerra–Young exchange (CHRG-118shrg62795_p0115 and p0118) has explicit expectation-management (“I wish I could say yes… the process does not move… as quickly”; “from a management perspective… minimize that delay?”).
